title: The stone head at night
logline: The face by the wall at night, lit from below by a phone's light held by someone out of frame, the moss white in it, the eyes deeper. Whoever holds the phone: not drawn. The monument nobody remembers, remembered for a second.

panels.composition: The moss-grown carved stone face in grass at night lit from below by the white glare of a phone held out of frame, the shingle wall behind it black, the eyes deep shadows.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a moss-grown carved stone face in grass at night lit from below by the white glare of a phone held out of frame, a shingle wall black behind it and its eyes in deep shadow, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Lit for a second by someone not drawn.
